answer: Simple-chain PPR is catch multiplied by the configured taxon coefficient, with the documented unit conversion where needed. The project evaluates the annual catch first: genuine recorded zero catch gives PPR = 0 even when TL/coefficient is unavailable, because no caught mass contributes PPR. This does not assign or repair the missing TL/coefficient. Positive catch with an unavailable coefficient has unknown PPR, since the required PPR per unit catch is undetermined; report it as unavailable rather than zero. Missing catch also remains unknown. Missing coefficients confined to zero-catch taxa do not make that year's total incomplete; unknown positive-catch contributions require an explicitly labelled known-PPR subtotal. Simple-chain PPR is independent of Ecopath group mapping and GE/TE coefficients.
